title.en: MGM official film page for The Terminator

notes.zh: 用于核对作品身份、发行或发表信息。
notes.en: Used to verify the work identity, release, or publication information.

notes.zh: 影片片名标识资料；已按 Commons 文件页实际地址重新下载。文件页注明矢量化作者 Amberrock、公共领域状态及商标限制；不作为电影剧照。
notes.en: Film title reference; re-downloaded from the actual Commons file URL. The file page identifies vectorizer Amberrock, marks the work public domain and notes trademark restrictions; it is not a film still.

notes.zh: TMDB 图片库用于定位海报、影片场面与宣传视觉；每张图片的原始文件链接保留在对应资源记录中。
notes.en: The TMDB gallery is used to locate posters, film scenes and promotional visuals; each original file URL is retained in the corresponding asset record.
